mapper.select: SELECT payment_instruction_id AS paymentInstructionId, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN debit_credit = 'CREDIT' THEN amount WHEN debit_credit = 'DEBIT' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS netAmount FROM ledger WHERE posting_date = #{businessDate} AND account_id = #{clearingAccountId} AND journal_type IN ('CLEARING_PENDING', 'REVERSAL_CLEARING_PENDING') AND payment_instruction_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_instruction_id

SELECT our_payment_instruction_id AS paymentInstructionId, clearing_amount AS amount, clearing_status AS status FROM kftc_clearing_transaction WHERE COALESCE(settlement_date, SUBSTRING(clearing_requested_at, 1, 8)) = #{businessDate}

SELECT our_payment_instruction_id AS paymentInstructionId, settlement_amount AS amount, settlement_status AS status FROM bok_settlement_transaction WHERE COALESCE(settlement_date, SUBSTRING(settlement_requested_at, 1, 8)) = #{businessDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_break ( business_date, network, payment_instruction_id, break_type, internal_amount, external_amount, external_status, detail, resolution_status, first_detected_at, last_detected_at ) VALUES ( #{businessDate}, #{network}, #{b.paymentInstructionId}, #{b.type}, #{b.internalAmount}, #{b.externalAmount}, #{b.externalStatus}, #{b.detail}, 'OPEN', #{now}, #{now} ) ON CONFLICT (business_date, network, payment_instruction_id, break_type) DO UPDATE SET internal_amount = EXCLUDED.internal_amount, external_amount = EXCLUDED.external_amount, external_status = EXCLUDED.external_status, detail = EXCLUDED.detail, last_detected_at = EXCLUDED.last_detected_at
mapper.select: SELECT break_type AS breakType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM reconciliation_break WHERE resolution_status IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING') GROUP BY break_type
